name: Yuurei Okuchi ~Tengoku Jigoku~
source:
At an old abandoned mansion outside town, some troublesome ghosts have appeared. It seems one man has set out to deal with the apparitions.

However, the result was a little unexpected...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ293815.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
鎮外一座廢棄的古老宅邸裡，出現了幾個惹麻煩的幽靈。似乎有個男人已經動身，準備前去解決這些幽靈。

然而，結果卻有些出乎意料……
